sections.Profile:
The "Tales from the Crypt" pinball machine, released by Data East in November 1993, is a horror-themed game designed by John Borg. It features artwork by Kurt Andersen and Markus Rothkranz, and sound design by Brian Schmidt. The machine's design is heavily inspired by the TV series of the same name, incorporating its campy humor and gory visuals.
